hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_FILE_PATH" | grep -q "\.rs$" && grep -n "\.unwrap()\|\.expect(" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "#\[cfg(test)\]" | grep -v "mod tests" | grep -v "// test" | head -5 | while read line; do echo "[unwrap-check] $line"; done || true'
bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE "bindings\.rs$" && echo "BLOCK: bindings.rs is auto-generated by wit-bindgen. Do not edit directly." && exit 1 || exit 0'
